```{r, results='hide'}
library(table1)


pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
    # Construct vectors of data y, and groups (strata) g
    y <- unlist(x)
    g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
    if (is.numeric(y)) {
        # For numeric variables, perform a standard 2-sample t-test
        p <- t.test(y ~ g)$p.value
    } else {
        # For categorical variables, perform a chi-squared test of independence
        p <- chisq.test(table(y, g))$p.value
    }
    # Format the p-value, using an HTML entity for the less-than sign.
    # The initial empty string places the output on the line below the variable label.
    c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}
```

```{r}
for (name in names(dataset_list)) {
  df <- dataset_list[[name]]
  
  mdp_long <- df %>%
    select(country, starts_with("d")) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("d"),
      names_to = "Item",
      values_to = "value"
    )
  
  chisq_results <- mdp_long %>%
    group_by(Item) %>%
    summarise(
      p_value = tryCatch(
        chisq.test(table(country, value))$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
  
  mdp_country <- mdp_long %>%
    group_by(country, Item) %>%
    summarise(
      Percent = mean(value == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(chisq_results, by = "Item") %>%
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  sig_labels <- mdp_country %>%
    group_by(Item) %>%
    summarise(
      Percent = max(Percent) + 5,
      sig = unique(sig),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(mdp_country, aes(x = Item, y = Percent, fill = country)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
    coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10)) +  
    scale_x_discrete(labels = item_labels) +
    scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("AFG" = "Afghanistan",    
                                   "PK"  = "Pakistan",
                                   "SA"  = "South Africa"))+
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      x = "Deprivation Items",
      y = "% of Headcounts deprived in each dimension",
      title = paste("Deprivation by Item:", name, "(by Country)"),
      fill = "Country"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = sig_labels,
      aes(x = Item, y = Percent, label = sig),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 5
    )
  
  ggsave(
    paste0("./newresults/Figurs_Poverty Head Counts by Dementia Status, Gender, and Age Groups/mdp_deprivation_", name, "_by_country.jpg"),
    plot = p,
    width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300
  )
  
  message("Saved: ", name)
}
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(MPI)



#---------------------------
# 1. Select data
#---------------------------
Mp_subset_all <- Mp_no_dementia %>%
  select(starts_with("d"))

Mp_subset_country <- Mp_no_dementia %>%
  select(starts_with("d"), country)

#---------------------------
# 2. Run AF_Seq for k = 1:12
#---------------------------
all_results <- lapply(1:12, function(k) {
  AF_Seq(df = Mp_subset_all, k = k)
})

country_results <- lapply(1:12, function(k) {
  AF_Seq(df = Mp_subset_country, g = "country", k = k)
})

#---------------------------
# 3. Function to extract H, A, M0
#---------------------------
extract_HAM0 <- function(x) {
  c(x$H, x$A, x$M0)
}

#---------------------------
# 4. Build each row
#---------------------------
table_rows <- lapply(1:12, function(k) {
  c(
    k,
    extract_HAM0(all_results[[k]][[1]]),   # all together
    extract_HAM0(country_results[[k]][[1]]), # Afghanistan
    extract_HAM0(country_results[[k]][[2]]), # Pakistan
    extract_HAM0(country_results[[k]][[3]])  # South Africa
  )
})

#---------------------------
# 5. Combine into final table
#---------------------------
table4 <- do.call(rbind, table_rows)
table4 <- as.data.frame(table4)

colnames(table4) <- c(
  "K",
  "All_H", "All_A", "All_M0",
  "AFG_H", "AFG_A", "AFG_M0",
  "PK_H", "PK_A", "PK_M0",
  "SA_H", "SA_A", "SA_M0"
)

# optional: add header row similar to your old format
table4_display <- rbind(
  c("K", "H", "A", "M0", "H", "A", "M0", "H", "A", "M0", "H", "A", "M0"),
  table4
)

  "",
  "All Together", "", "",
  "Afghanistan", "", "",
  "Pakistan", "", "",
  "South Africa", "", ""
)

#---------------------------
# 6. Save
#---------------------------
write.csv(table4_display, "../results/table4 no dementia. csv")

write.csv(table4, "../results/table4 no dementia.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

#table 4 code
```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(MPI)



#--------------------------------------------------
# 1. Function to create Table 4 for one dataset
#--------------------------------------------------
make_table4 <- function(data, group_var = "country", max_k = 12) {
  
  # data without group variable
  data_all <- data %>%
    select(starts_with("d"))
  
  # data with group variable
  data_group <- data %>%
    select(starts_with("d"), all_of(group_var))
  
  # run AF_Seq for all k
  all_results <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_all, k = k)
  })
  
  group_results <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_group, g = group_var, k = k)
  })
  
  # helper function
  extract_HAM0 <- function(x) {
    c(x$H, x$A, x$M0)
  }
  
  # get group names from the dataset
  grp_levels <- c("AFG", "PK", "SA")
  grp_levels <- grp_levels[grp_levels %in% unique(as.character(data_group[[group_var]]))]  
  # build rows
  table_rows <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    row_vals <- c(
      k,
      extract_HAM0(all_results[[k]][[1]])
    )
    
    for (j in seq_along(grp_levels)) {
      row_vals <- c(row_vals, extract_HAM0(group_results[[k]][[j]]))
    }
    
    row_vals
  })
  
  table_out <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, table_rows))
  
  # column names
  cn <- c("K", "All_H", "All_A", "All_M0")
  for (g in grp_levels) {
    cn <- c(cn, paste0(g, "_H"), paste0(g, "_A"), paste0(g, "_M0"))
  }
  colnames(table_out) <- cn
  
  return(table_out)
  
}

extract_M0_only <- function(tab) {
  tab %>%
    select(K, ends_with("_M0"))
}




```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

freq(MP_all$rudas_c)
library(MPI)

#--------------------------------------------------
# 1. Function to create Table 4 for one dataset
#--------------------------------------------------
make_table4 <- function(data, group_var = "rudas_c", max_k = 12) {
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(group_var), ~ trimws(as.character(.x))))
  
  groups <- c("cn", "mild", "moderate")
  
  extract_HAM0 <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(c(H = NA, A = NA, M0 = NA))
    c(H = x$H, A = x$A, M0 = x$M0)
  }
  
  table_rows <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    
    data_all <- data %>%
      select(starts_with("d"))
    
    all_result <- AF_Seq(df = data_all, k = k)[[1]]
    
    row_vals <- c(
      K = k,
      All_H = all_result$H,
      All_A = all_result$A,
      All_M0 = all_result$M0
    )
    
    for (g in groups) {
      
      data_g <- data %>%
        filter(.data[[group_var]] == g) %>%
        select(starts_with("d"))
      
      result_list <- AF_Seq(df = data_g, k = k)
      result_g <- result_list[[1]]
      
      row_vals <- c(
        row_vals,
        setNames(
          extract_HAM0(result_g),
          paste0(g, c("_H", "_A", "_M0"))
        )
      )
    }
    
    row_vals
  })
  
  as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, table_rows))
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(dunn.test)

make_table4 <- function(data, group_var = "rudas_c", max_k = 12,
                        dcols = NULL, weights = NULL) {

  data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(group_var), ~ trimws(as.character(.x))))

  groups <- c("cn", "mild", "moderate")

  ## ---- per-person deprivation score (must match AF_Seq's weighting) ----
  if (is.null(dcols))   dcols   <- grep("^d", names(data), value = TRUE)
  ndim <- length(dcols)
  if (is.null(weights)) weights <- rep(1 / ndim, ndim)   # EQUAL weights by default
  D        <- as.matrix(data[dcols])
  ci_share <- as.numeric(D %*% weights)   # weighted deprivation share (0..1) -> feeds M0
  ki_count <- rowSums(D)                  # raw count 0..ndim -> defines "poor at cutoff k"

  extract_HAM0 <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(c(H = NA, A = NA, M0 = NA))
    c(H = x$H, A = x$A, M0 = x$M0)
  }

  ## ---- one Dunn's test at cutoff k, return cn-vs-mild & cn-vs-moderate p ----
  dunn_vs_cn <- function(k) {
    censored <- ci_share * (ki_count >= k)            # censored score (0 if not poor at k)
    keep <- data[[group_var]] %in% groups & !is.na(censored)
    s  <- censored[keep]
    gg <- factor(data[[group_var]][keep], levels = groups)
    out <- c(mild = NA_real_, moderate = NA_real_)
    # need >=2 non-empty groups AND some spread, else Dunn/KW is undefined
    if (nlevels(droplevels(gg)) < 2 || length(unique(s)) < 2) return(out)
    dt <- dunn.test(s, gg, method = "bonferroni", kw = TRUE,
                    table = FALSE, list = FALSE, altp = FALSE)
    for (g in c("mild", "moderate")) {
      idx <- which(dt$comparisons %in% c(paste("cn -", g), paste(g, "- cn")))
      if (length(idx)) out[g] <- dt$P.adjusted[idx[1]]
    }
    out
  }

  table_rows <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {

    all_result <- AF_Seq(df = select(data, starts_with("d")), k = k)[[1]]
    row_vals <- c(K = k, All_H = all_result$H,
                  All_A = all_result$A, All_M0 = all_result$M0)

    m0 <- c()
    for (g in groups) {
      data_g   <- data %>% filter(.data[[group_var]] == g) %>% select(starts_with("d"))
      result_g <- AF_Seq(df = data_g, k = k)[[1]]
      ham      <- extract_HAM0(result_g)
      m0[g]    <- ham["M0"]
      row_vals <- c(row_vals, setNames(ham, paste0(g, c("_H", "_A", "_M0"))))
    }

    ## ---- NEW: % difference in M0 vs cn, and Dunn p-value vs cn ----
    pvals <- dunn_vs_cn(k)
    for (g in c("mild", "moderate")) {
      pct <- (m0[[g]] - m0[["cn"]]) / m0[["cn"]]
      row_vals <- c(row_vals,
                    setNames(pct,       paste0(g, "_pctdiff_M0")),
                    setNames(pvals[[g]], paste0(g, "_p_vs_cn")))
    }
    row_vals
  })

  as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, table_rows))
}
```

```{r}
make_table4 <- function(data, group_var = "rudas_c", max_k = 12) {
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(group_var), ~ trimws(as.character(.x))))
  
  groups <- sort(unique(na.omit(data[[group_var]])))
  
  extract_HAM0 <- function(x) {
    c(H = x$H, A = x$A, M0 = x$M0)
  }
  
  table_rows <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    
    all_result <- AF_Seq(
      df = data %>% select(starts_with("d")),
      k = k
    )[[1]]
    
    row_vals <- c(
      K = k,
      All_H = all_result$H,
      All_A = all_result$A,
      All_M0 = all_result$M0
    )
    
    for (g in groups) {
      
      data_g <- data %>%
        filter(.data[[group_var]] == g) %>%
        select(starts_with("d"))
      
      result_g <- AF_Seq(df = data_g, k = k)[[1]]
      
      row_vals <- c(
        row_vals,
        setNames(
          extract_HAM0(result_g),
          paste0(g, c("_H", "_A", "_M0"))
        )
      )
    }
    
    row_vals
  })
  
  as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, table_rows))
}
```

# Dimension contribution


```{r}
extract_diCont_table <- function(data, dataset_name, max_k = 12) {
  
  data_all <- data %>%
    select(starts_with("d"))
  
  var_names <- names(data_all)
  
  res_list <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_all, k = k)
  })
  
  out <- lapply(seq_along(res_list), function(i) {
    k <- i
    
    di <- res_list[[i]][[1]]$DimentionalContribution$diCont
    di_vals <- as.numeric(di)
    
    # if AF_Seq does not keep names, use original variable names
    di_names <- names(di)
    if (is.null(di_names) || length(di_names) == 0) {
      di_names <- var_names[seq_along(di_vals)]
    }
    
    # make sure lengths match
    data.frame(
      Dataset = rep(dataset_name, length(di_vals)),
      k = rep(k, length(di_vals)),
      Dimension = di_names,
      diCont = di_vals,
      row.names = NULL
    )
  })
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

extract_diCont_table_by_group <- function(data, dataset_name, group_var = "rudas_c", max_k = 12) {
  
  library(dplyr)
  
  # keep deprivation variables + grouping variable
  data_group <- data %>%
    select(starts_with("d"), all_of(group_var))
  
  # names of deprivation variables
  var_names <- data_group %>%
    select(starts_with("d")) %>%
    names()
  
  # group levels in the data
  grp_levels <- unique(as.character(data_group[[group_var]]))
  
  # run AF_Seq for each k
  res_list <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_group, g = group_var, k = k)
  })
  
  # extract results
  out <- lapply(seq_along(res_list), function(i) {
    k <- i
    res_k <- res_list[[i]]
    
    # for each group
    group_out <- lapply(seq_along(grp_levels), function(j) {
      
      # protect against missing group result
      if (length(res_k) < j || is.null(res_k[[j]])) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      di <- res_k[[j]]$DimentionalContribution$diCont
      
      # protect against missing diCont
      if (is.null(di)) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      di_vals <- as.numeric(di)
      
      # skip if empty
      if (length(di_vals) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      di_names <- names(di)
      
      # if no names, use original deprivation variable names
      if (is.null(di_names) || length(di_names) == 0) {
        di_names <- var_names[seq_along(di_vals)]
      }
      
      # if lengths still do not match, trim to shortest length
      n <- min(length(di_vals), length(di_names))
      
      data.frame(
        Dataset   = rep(dataset_name, n),
        Group     = rep(grp_levels[j], n),
        k         = rep(k, n),
        Dimension = di_names[1:n],
        diCont    = di_vals[1:n],
        row.names = NULL
      )
    })
    
    bind_rows(group_out)
  })
  
  bind_rows(out)
}



diCont_group_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  dataset_list,
  ~extract_diCont_table_by_group(.x, .y, group_var = "country", max_k = 12)
)

write.xlsx(diCont_group_all, "./newresults/diCont_all_datasets.xlsx")
```

```{r}

extract_diCont_wide_all_group <- function(data, dataset_name, group_var = "rudas_c", max_k = 12) {
  
  # overall data
  data_all <- data %>%
    select(starts_with("d"))
  
  # grouped data
  data_group <- data %>%
    select(starts_with("d"), all_of(group_var))
  
  # deprivation variable names
  var_names <- names(data_all)
  
  # fixed group order
  grp_levels <- c("cn", "mild", "moderate")
  grp_levels <- grp_levels[grp_levels %in% unique(as.character(data_group[[group_var]]))]
  
  # -------------------------
  # 1. overall results
  # -------------------------
  res_all <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_all, k = k)
  })
  
  long_all <- lapply(seq_along(res_all), function(i) {
    k <- i
    
    di <- res_all[[i]][[1]]$DimentionalContribution$diCont
    if (is.null(di)) return(NULL)
    
    di_vals <- as.numeric(di)
    if (length(di_vals) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    di_names <- names(di)
    if (is.null(di_names) || length(di_names) == 0) {
      di_names <- var_names[seq_along(di_vals)]
    }
    
    n <- min(length(di_vals), length(di_names))
    
    data.frame(
      Dimension = di_names[1:n],
      Group = "All",
      k = paste0("k", k),
      diCont = di_vals[1:n],
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  # -------------------------
  # 2. grouped results
  # -------------------------
  res_group <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_group, g = group_var, k = k)
  })
  
  long_group <- lapply(seq_along(res_group), function(i) {
    k <- i
    res_k <- res_group[[i]]
    
    bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(grp_levels), function(j) {
      if (length(res_k) < j || is.null(res_k[[j]])) return(NULL)
      
      di <- res_k[[j]]$DimentionalContribution$diCont
      if (is.null(di)) return(NULL)
      
      di_vals <- as.numeric(di)
      if (length(di_vals) == 0) return(NULL)
      
      di_names <- names(di)
      if (is.null(di_names) || length(di_names) == 0) {
        di_names <- var_names[seq_along(di_vals)]
      }
      
      n <- min(length(di_vals), length(di_names))
      
      data.frame(
        Dimension = di_names[1:n],
        Group = grp_levels[j],
        k = paste0("k", k),
        diCont = di_vals[1:n],
        row.names = NULL
      )
    }))
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  # combine overall + country
  long_out <- bind_rows(long_all, long_group)
  
  # wide format
  wide_out <- long_out %>%
    mutate(Group_k = paste(Group, k, sep = "_")) %>%
    select(Dimension, Group_k, diCont) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group_k, values_from = diCont, values_fill = NA)
  
  # ===== FIX: Build desired columns and ensure they exist =====
  # Create all expected column combinations
  all_cols <- c("All", grp_levels)
  k_vals <- paste0("k", 1:max_k)
  
  # Generate all combinations in desired order
  desired_group_k <- c(
    paste0("All_", k_vals),
    as.vector(t(outer(grp_levels, k_vals, paste, sep = "_")))
  )
  
  # Filter to only columns that exist in wide_out
  desired_group_k <- desired_group_k[desired_group_k %in% names(wide_out)]
  
  # Reorder and select
  wide_out <- wide_out %>% 
    select(Dimension, all_of(desired_group_k))
  
  return(wide_out)
  
}

diCont_tables <- imap(
  dataset_list,
  ~extract_diCont_wide_all_group(
    data = .x,
    dataset_name = .y,
    group_var = "rudas_c",
    max_k = 12
  )
)

# Convert to format with rownames (Dimension as row names)
diCont_tables_rownames <- lapply(diCont_tables, function(df) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  rownames(df) <- df$Dimension
  df$Dimension <- NULL
  df
})
```

```{r}
extract_diCont_wide_all_group <- function(data, dataset_name, group_var = "rudas_c", max_k = 12) {

  # overall data
  data_all <- data %>%
    select(starts_with("d"))

  # grouped data
  data_group <- data %>%
    select(starts_with("d"), all_of(group_var))

  # deprivation variable names
  var_names <- names(data_all)

  # fixed group order
  grp_levels <- c("cn", "mild", "moderate")
  grp_levels <- grp_levels[grp_levels %in% unique(as.character(data_group[[group_var]]))]

  # -------------------------
  # 1. overall results
  # -------------------------
  res_all <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_all, k = k)
  })

  long_all <- lapply(seq_along(res_all), function(i) {
    k <- i

    di <- res_all[[i]][[1]]$DimentionalContribution$diCont
    if (is.null(di)) return(NULL)

    di_vals <- as.numeric(di)
    if (length(di_vals) == 0) return(NULL)

    di_names <- names(di)
    if (is.null(di_names) || length(di_names) == 0) {
      di_names <- var_names[seq_along(di_vals)]
    }

    n <- min(length(di_vals), length(di_names))

    data.frame(
      Dimension = di_names[1:n],
      Group = "All",
      k = paste0("k", k),
      diCont = di_vals[1:n],
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  
  # combine overall + country
  long_out <- bind_rows(long_all, long_group)

  # wide format
  wide_out <- long_out %>%
    mutate(Group_k = paste(Group, k, sep = "_")) %>%
    select(Dimension, Group_k, diCont) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group_k, values_from = diCont)  # fixed: was Cont

  # desired column order: All k1-12, then AFG k1-12, PK k1-12, SA k1-12
  desired_cols <- c(
    "Dimension",
    paste0("All_k", 1:max_k),
    as.vector(t(outer(grp_levels, paste0("k", 1:max_k), paste, sep = "_")))  # fixed: ad
  )

  desired_cols <- desired_cols[desired_cols %in% names(wide_out)]
  wide_out <- wide_out %>% select(all_of(desired_cols))

  return(wide_out)
}

    dataset_name = .y,
    group_var = "rudas_c",

  )
)

diCont_tables_rownames <- lapply(diCont_tables, function(df) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)

  df$Dimension <- NULL

})
```

```{r}
extract_diCont_wide_all_group <- function(data, dataset_name, group_var = "rudas_c", max_k = 12){

  # overall data
  data_all <- data %>%
    select(starts_with("d"))

  # grouped data
  data_group <- data %>%
    select(starts_with("d"), all_of(group_var))

  # deprivation variable names
  var_names <- names(data_all)

  # fixed group order
  grp_levels <- c("cn", "mild", "moderate")
  grp_levels <-  grp_levels[grp_levels %in% unique(as.character(data_group[[group_var]]))]

  # -------------------------
  # 1. overall results
  # -------------------------
  res_all <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_all, k = k)
  })

  long_all <- lapply(seq_along(res_all), function(i) {
    k <- i

    di <- res_all[[i]][[1]]$DimentionalContribution$diCont
    if (is.null(di)) return(NULL)

    di_vals <- as.numeric(di)
    if (length(di_vals) == 0) return(NULL)

    di_names <- names(di)
    if (is.null(di_names) || length(di_names) == 0) {
      di_names <- var_names[seq_along(di_vals)]
    }

    n <- min(length(di_vals), length(di_names))

    data.frame(
      Dimension = di_names[1:n],
      Group = "All",
      k = paste0("k", k),
      diCont = di_vals[1:n],
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  # -------------------------
  # 2. grouped results
  # -------------------------
  res_group <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_group, g = group_var, k = k)
  })

  long_group <- lapply(seq_along(res_group), function(i) {
    k <- i
    res_k <- res_group[[i]]

    bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(grp_levels), function(j) {
      if (length(res_k) < j || is.null(res_k[[j]])) return(NULL)

      di <- res_k[[j]]$DimentionalContribution$diCont
      if (is.null(di)) return(NULL)

      di_vals <- as.numeric(di)
      if (length(di_vals) == 0) return(NULL)

      di_names <- names(di)
      if (is.null(di_names) || length(di_names) == 0) {
        di_names <- var_names[seq_along(di_vals)]
      }

      n <- min(length(di_vals), length(di_names))

      data.frame(
        Dimension = di_names[1:n],
        Group = grp_levels[j],
        k = paste0("k", k),
        diCont = di_vals[1:n],
        row.names = NULL
      )
    }))
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  # combine overall + country
  long_out <- bind_rows(long_all, long_group)

  # wide format
  wide_out <- long_out %>%
    mutate(Group_k = paste(Group, k, sep = "_")) %>%
    select(Dimension, Group_k, diCont) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group_k, values_from = diCont)  # fi

  # desired column order: All k1-12, then AFG k1-12, PK k1-12, SA
  desired_cols <-c(
    "Dimension",
    paste0("All_k", 1:max_k),
    as.vector(t(outer(grp_levels, paste0("k", 1:max_k), paste, sep = "_")))
  )

  desired_cols <- desired_cols[desired_cols %in% names(wide_out)]
  wide_out <- wide_out %>% select(all_of(desired_cols))

  return(wide_out)
}


diCont_tables <- imap(
  dataset_list,
  ~extract_diCont_wide_all_group(
    data = .x,
    dataset_name = .y,
    group_var = "country",
    max_k = 12
  )
)

diCont_tables_rownames <- lapply(diCont_tables, function(df) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  rownames(df) <- df$Dimension
  df$Dimension <- NULL
  df
})

write.xlsx(
  diCont_tables_rownames,
  file = "./newresults/diCont_all_datasets_rowname_2.xlsx",
  rowNames = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
extract_diCont_transposed <- function(data, dataset_name, group_var = "rudas_c", max_k = 12) {
  
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  
  # overall + grouped data
  data_all <- data %>% select(starts_with("d"))
  data_group <- data %>% select(starts_with("d"), all_of(group_var))
  
  var_names <- names(data_all)
  
  # fixed country order
  grp_levels <- c("cn", "mild", "moderate")
  grp_levels <- grp_levels[grp_levels %in% unique(as.character(data_group[[group_var]]))]
  
  # -------------------------
  # 1. overall
  # -------------------------
  res_all <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_all, k = k)
  })
  
  long_all <- lapply(seq_along(res_all), function(i) {
    k <- paste0("k", i)
    
    di <- res_all[[i]][[1]]$DimentionalContribution$diCont
    if (is.null(di)) return(NULL)
    
    di_vals <- as.numeric(di)
    if (length(di_vals) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    di_names <- names(di)
    if (is.null(di_names) || length(di_names) == 0) {
      di_names <- var_names[seq_along(di_vals)]
    }
    
    n <- min(length(di_vals), length(di_names))
    
    data.frame(
      k = rep(k, n),
      Group = "All",
      Dimension = di_names[1:n],
      diCont = di_vals[1:n]
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  # -------------------------
  # 2. grouped
  # -------------------------
  res_group <- lapply(1:max_k, function(k) {
    AF_Seq(df = data_group, g = group_var, k = k)
  })
  
  long_group <- lapply(seq_along(res_group), function(i) {
    k <- paste0("k", i)
    res_k <- res_group[[i]]
    
    bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(grp_levels), function(j) {
      if (length(res_k) < j || is.null(res_k[[j]])) return(NULL)
      
      di <- res_k[[j]]$DimentionalContribution$diCont
      if (is.null(di)) return(NULL)
      
      di_vals <- as.numeric(di)
      if (length(di_vals) == 0) return(NULL)
      
      di_names <- names(di)
      if (is.null(di_names) || length(di_names) == 0) {
        di_names <- var_names[seq_along(di_vals)]
      }
      
      n <- min(length(di_vals), length(di_names))
      
      data.frame(
        k = rep(k, n),
        Group = grp_levels[j],
        Dimension = di_names[1:n],
        diCont = di_vals[1:n]
      )
    }))
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  # combine
  long_all_data <- bind_rows(long_all, long_group)
  
  # create column names like All_d1_Edu, AFG_d2_Disab, etc.
  long_all_data <- long_all_data %>%
    mutate(Group_Dim = paste(Group, Dimension, sep = "_"))
  
  # pivot: rows = k, columns = dimensions
  wide_out <- long_all_data %>%
    select(k, Group_Dim, diCont) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group_Dim, values_from = diCont)
  
  # order columns nicely
  desired_cols <- c(
    "k",
    paste0("All_", var_names),
    as.vector(outer(grp_levels, var_names, paste, sep = "_"))
  )
  
  desired_cols <- desired_cols[desired_cols %in% names(wide_out)]
  wide_out <- wide_out %>% select(all_of(desired_cols))
  
  return(wide_out)
}

diCont_tables_transposed <- purrr::imap(
  dataset_list,
  ~extract_diCont_transposed(
    data = .x,
    dataset_name = .y,
    group_var = "rudas_c",
    max_k = 12
  )
)
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  diCont_tables_transposed,
  file = "./newresults/diCont_all_transposed.xlsx"
)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(fmsb)
library(scales)

library(dplyr)
library(MPI)



make_spider_chart <- function(data,
                              dataset_name,
                              out_dir = "newresults/spider_webs",
                              k = 4,
                              group_var = "country",
                              max_scale = 50) {
  
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  df_sub <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(starts_with("d"), all_of(group_var))
  
  dimension_contribution <- AF_Seq(df = df_sub, k = k, g = group_var)
  dimension_contribution_weighted <- AF_Seq(df = df_sub, g = group_var)
  
  extract_md <- function(weighted_obj, unweighted_obj) {
    tab <- weighted_obj$pov_df
    tab$Cvector <- NULL
    tab$Intensity <- NULL
    tab$IsPoverty <- NULL
    
    tab <- dplyr::bind_cols(tab, unweighted_obj$pov_df["IsPoverty"])
    tab_poverty <- tab[tab$IsPoverty == 1, , drop = FALSE]
    tab_poverty$IsPoverty <- NULL
    
    r1 <- colSums(tab_poverty, na.rm = TRUE)
    r2 <- sum(r1, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (r2 == 0) {
      return(rep(0, length(r1)))
    } else {
      return(r1 / r2)
    }
    
    # Replace any NaN and NA values with 0
    result[is.nan(result)] <- 0
    result[is.na(result)] <- 0
    
  return(result)
    
  }
  
  MD_list <- lapply(seq_along(dimension_contribution_weighted), function(i) {
    extract_md(dimension_contribution_weighted[[i]], dimension_contribution[[i]])
  })
  
  di_count <- dplyr::bind_rows(MD_list)
  
# Replace any remaining NaN and NA with 0
  di_count <- di_count %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.), 0, .))) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0)))

  
  if (nrow(di_count) == 3) {
    rownames(di_count) <- c("Afghanistan", "Pakistan", "South Africa")
  }
  
  di_count$Education  <- di_count$d1_edu
  di_count$Health     <- di_count$d2_disab
  di_count$Household  <- di_count$d3_housing + di_count$d4_cleanwater + di_count$d5_cooking+di_count$d7_lighting+di_count$d6_heating +    di_count$d8_sanitation
  di_count$Employment <- di_count$d10_Emp_ad
  di_count$Stigma     <- di_count$d11_Stigma
  di_count$Psychological <- di_count$d12_depression+di_count$d13_Distress
  
  radar_web <- di_count[, c("Education","Health","Household",
                            "Employment","Stigma","Psychological")]
  
  write.csv(radar_web,
            file.path(out_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_radar_values.csv")),
            row.names = TRUE)
  
  data2 <- radar_web * 100
  data2 <- rbind(rep(max_scale, 6), rep(0, 6), data2)
  
  coul <- c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3")
  colors_border <- coul
  colors_in <- scales::alpha(coul, 0.3)
  
pdf(file.path(out_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_spider.pdf")),
    width = 8, height = 6)

#tiff(file.path(out_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_spider.tiff")),
     #width = 6, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300)
 
  op <- par(mar = c(3, 4, 4, 6))
  
  fmsb::radarchart(
    data2,
    axistype = 1,
    pcol = colors_border,
    pfcol = colors_in,
    plwd = 2,
    plty = 1,
    vlabels = c("Education",
                "Healthcare",
                "Household",
                "Employment",
                "Stigma",
                "Psychological"),
    cglcol = "grey",
    cglty = 1,
    axislabcol = "grey",
    caxislabels = c("0", "", "25%", "", "50%"),
    cglwd = 0.8,
    calcex = 0.8,
    vlcex = 0.8
  )
  

  
  par(op)
  dev.off()
  
  return(radar_web)
}
```

# spider web made from claude, which taken care of missing value, and replace as 0.  


             weight = c(1/6, 1/6, 1/36, 1/36, 1/36, 1/36, 1/36, 1/36, 1/6, 1/6, 1/12, 1/12),

```{r}
# Make the spider web function
library(dplyr)
library(fmsb)
library(scales)

make_spider_chart <- function(data,
                              dataset_name,
                              out_dir = "newresults/spider_webs",
                              k = 4,
                              group_var = "rudas_3c",
                              weight = c(1/12, 1/12, 1/12, 1/12, 1/12, 1/12, 1/12, 1/12, 1/12, 1/12, 1/12, 1/12),
                              max_scale = 50) {
  
  # Create output directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
    dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Select dimensions (d variables) and grouping variable
  df_sub <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(starts_with("d"), all_of(group_var))
  
  # Calculate dimension contributions
  dimension_contribution <- AF_Seq(df = df_sub, k = k, g = group_var)
  dimension_contribution_weighted <- AF_Seq(df = df_sub, g = group_var, w = weight)
  
  # Extract multidimensional poverty contributions
  extract_md <- function(weighted_obj, unweighted_obj) {
    tab <- weighted_obj$pov_df
    
    # Remove unnecessary columns
    tab$Cvector <- NULL
    tab$Intensity <- NULL
    tab$IsPoverty <- NULL
    
    # Add poverty indicator
    tab <- dplyr::bind_cols(tab, unweighted_obj$pov_df["IsPoverty"])
    
    # Filter to poor individuals only
    tab_poverty <- tab[tab$IsPoverty == 1, , drop = FALSE]
    tab_poverty$IsPoverty <- NULL
    
    # Calculate sums and proportions
    r1 <- colSums(tab_poverty, na.rm = TRUE)
    r2 <- sum(r1, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Return result with proper handling of edge cases
    if (r2 == 0) {
      result <- setNames(rep(0, length(r1)), names(r1))
    } else {
      result <- r1 / r2
    }
    
    # Replace any NaN and NA values with 0
    result[is.nan(result)] <- 0
    result[is.na(result)] <- 0
    
    return(result)
  }
  
  # Apply extraction to all groups
  MD_list <- lapply(seq_along(dimension_contribution_weighted), function(i) {
    result <- extract_md(dimension_contribution_weighted[[i]], dimension_contribution[[i]])
    as.data.frame(t(result))  # Convert to data frame
  })
  
  # Bind all results into one data frame
  di_count <- dplyr::bind_rows(MD_list)
  
  # Replace any remaining NaN and NA with 0
  di_count <- di_count %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.), 0, .))) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0)))
  
  # Add country names if 3 rows
  if (nrow(di_count) == 3) {
    di_count <- di_count %>%
      mutate(Country = c("Afghanistan", "Pakistan", "South Africa"), .before = 1)
  }
  
  # Create composite dimensions
  di_count <- di_count %>%
    mutate(
      Education = d1_edu,
      Health = d2_disab,
      Household = d3_housing + d4_cleanwater + d5_cooking + d7_lighting + d6_heating + d8_sanitation,
      Employment = d10_Emp_ad,
      Stigma = d11_Stigma,
      Psychological = d12_depression + d13_Distress,
      .keep = "unused"
    )
  
  # Select only the composite dimensions
  radar_web <- di_count %>%
    dplyr::select(Country, Education, Health, Household, Employment, Stigma, Psychological)
  
  # Replace any NaN in final radar_web
  radar_web <- radar_web %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.), 0, .))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(., 0)))
  
  # Save radar values to CSV
  write.csv(
    radar_web,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_radar_values.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # Prepare data for radar chart (scale to percentages)
  radar_data <- radar_web %>%
    dplyr::select(-Country) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ . * 100))  # Keep as data frame
  
  # Add max and min rows for radar chart
  radar_data <- rbind(
    rep(max_scale, ncol(radar_data)),
    rep(0, ncol(radar_data)),
    radar_data
  )
  
  # Ensure it's a data frame
  radar_data <- as.data.frame(radar_data)
  
  # Set up colors
  num_countries <- nrow(radar_web)
  coul <- c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3")[1:num_countries]
  colors_border <- coul
  colors_in <- scales::alpha(colors_border, 0.3)
  
  # Create PDF
  pdf(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_spider.pdf")),
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
  
  # Set margins
  op <- par(mar = c(3, 4, 4, 6))
  
  # Create radar chart
  fmsb::radarchart(
    radar_data,
    axistype = 1,
    pcol = colors_border,
    pfcol = colors_in,
    plwd = 2,
    plty = 1,
    vlabels = c("Education", "Healthcare", "Household", "Employment", "Stigma", "Psychological"),
    cglcol = "grey",
    cglty = 1,
    axislabcol = "grey",
    caxislabels = c("0", "", "25%", "", "50%"),
    cglwd = 0.8,
    calcex = 0.8,
    vlcex = 0.8
  )
  
  # Add legend
  if (nrow(radar_web) > 0) {
    legend(
      x = "topright",
      legend = radar_web$Country,
      col = colors_border,
      lwd = 2,
      bty = "n"
    )
  }
  
  # Reset graphics parameters
  par(op)
  dev.off()
  
  return(radar_web)
}

freq(MP_all$rudas_3c)
```

#unadjusted model 
```{r}
library(MASS)
library(broom)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

# List of unadjusted models (one predictor at a time)

MP_all$poor<-0
MP_all$poor[MP_all$Cvector>0]=1

freq(MP_all$poor)

predictors <- c("poor", "age", "sex", "status","householdsize", "country")

# Function to fit a polr model and extract OR, CI, p-value
run_unadjusted <- function(pred) {
  form <- as.formula(paste("rudas_3c ~", pred))
  fit <- polr(form, data = MP_all, na.action = na.omit, Hess = TRUE)

  coef_table <- coef(summary(fit))

  # Keep only predictor coefficient rows (drop cutpoints like "1|2", "2|3")
  beta_rows <- !grepl("\\|", rownames(coef_table))
  coef_table <- coef_table[beta_rows, , drop = FALSE]

  p_vals <- pnorm(abs(coef_table[, "t value"]), lower.tail = FALSE) * 2

  ci <- tryCatch(confint(fit), error = function(e) confint.default(fit))
  if (!is.matrix(ci)) {
    ci <- matrix(ci, nrow = 1, dimnames = list(rownames(coef_table)[1], c("2.5 %", "97.5 %")))
  }

  # Match rows safely by name instead of assuming identical order/length
  ci_matched <- ci[rownames(coef_table), , drop = FALSE]

  data.frame(
    Predictor = pred,
    Term = rownames(coef_table),
    Estimate = coef_table[, "Value"],
    p.value = p_vals,
    conf.low = ci_matched[, 1],
    conf.high = ci_matched[, 2],
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

results_list <- lapply(predictors, run_unadjusted)
results_all <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

results_all <- results_all %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(Estimate),
    CI_low = exp(conf.low),
    CI_high = exp(conf.high)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Predictor,
    Term,
    OR = round(OR, 2),
    `95% CI Lower` = round(CI_low, 2),
    `95% CI Upper` = round(CI_high, 2),
    `p-value` = round(p.value, 5)
  )

# ---- Build formatted Excel workbook ----
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Unadjusted ORs")

writeData(wb, "Unadjusted ORs", results_all, startRow = 1, headerStyle = createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold", fgFill = "#D9E1F2", halign = "center", border = "TopBottomLeftRight"
))

setColWidths(wb, "Unadjusted ORs", cols = 1:6, widths = c(18, 22, 10, 14, 14, 10))
addStyle(wb, "Unadjusted ORs", style = createStyle(halign = "center", border = "TopBottomLeftRight"),
         rows = 2:(nrow(results_all) + 1), cols = 1:6, gridExpand = TRUE)

freezePane(wb, "Unadjusted ORs", firstRow = TRUE)

saveWorkbook(wb, "unadjusted_ORs.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
  Comparison = rep(rownames(coefs), each = ncol(coefs)),
  Predictor  = rep(colnames(coefs), times = nrow(coefs)),
  Estimate   = as.vector(t(coefs)),
  SE         = as.vector(t(ses)),
  z          = as.vector(t(zvals)),
  p          = as.vector(t(pvals)),
  OR         = as.vector(t(OR)),
  CI_lower   = as.vector(t(LL)),
  CI_upper   = as.vector(t(UL))
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(openxlsx)
library(fmsb)
library(scales)

make_spider_chart <- function(data,
                              dataset_name,
                              out_dir = "results/spider_webs",
                              k = 4,
                              group_var = "country",
                              weight = c(1/6,1/12,1/12,1/30,1/30,1/30,1/30,1/30,1/12,1/12,1/12,1/12),
                              max_scale = 50) {
  
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  df_sub <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(starts_with("d"), all_of(group_var))
  
  # unweighted object: used to define poverty status
  dimension_contribution <- AF_Seq(df = df_sub, k = k, g = group_var)
  
  # weighted object: used to calculate weighted dimension contribution
  dimension_contribution_weighted <- AF_Seq(df = df_sub, g = group_var, w = weight)
  
  extract_md <- function(weighted_obj, unweighted_obj) {
    tab <- weighted_obj$pov_df
    tab$Cvector <- NULL
    tab$Intensity <- NULL
    tab$IsPoverty <- NULL
    
    tab <- dplyr::bind_cols(tab, unweighted_obj$pov_df["IsPoverty"])
    tab_poverty <- tab[tab$IsPoverty == 1, , drop = FALSE]
    tab_poverty$IsPoverty <- NULL
    
    r1 <- colSums(tab_poverty, na.rm = TRUE)
    r2 <- sum(r1, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (r2 == 0) {
      return(rep(0, length(r1)))
    } else {
      return(r1 / r2)
    }
  }
  
  MD_list <- lapply(seq_along(dimension_contribution_weighted), function(i) {
    extract_md(dimension_contribution_weighted[[i]], dimension_contribution[[i]])
  })
  
  di_count <- dplyr::bind_rows(MD_list)
  
  if (nrow(di_count) == 3) {
    rownames(di_count) <- c("Afghanistan", "Pakistan", "South Africa")
  }
  
  # exportable full dimension table
  di_count_export <- di_count %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Group = rownames(di_count), .before = 1)
  
  dimension_table <- di_count_export %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Group,
      d1_Edu, d2_Disab, d3_food, d4_Housing, d5_Cleanwater,
      d6_Energy, d7_Sanitation, d8_assets, d9_Emp_ad,
      d10_Stigma, d11_Depression, d14_Distress
    )
  
  # collapsed radar domains
  di_count$Education <- di_count$d1_Edu
  di_count$Health <- di_count$d2_Disab + di_count$d3_food
  di_count$Household <- di_count$d4_Housing + di_count$d5_Cleanwater +
    di_count$d6_Energy + di_count$d7_Sanitation + di_count$d8_assets
  di_count$Employment <- di_count$d9_Emp_ad
  di_count$Stigma <- di_count$d10_Stigma
  di_count$Psychological <- di_count$d11_Depression + di_count$d14_Distress
  
  radar_web <- di_count[, c("Education", "Health", "Household",
                            "Employment", "Stigma", "Psychological")]
  
  radar_web_export <- radar_web %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Group = rownames(radar_web), .before = 1)
  
  # save csv
  write.csv(radar_web,
            file.path(out_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_radar_values.csv")),
            row.names = TRUE)
  
  # save Excel
  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "dimension_contribution")
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "dimension_contribution", dimension_table)
  
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "radar_domains")
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "radar_domains", radar_web_export)
  
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
    wb,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_spider_outputs.xlsx")),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
  
  # radar chart
  data2 <- radar_web * 100
  data2 <- rbind(rep(max_scale, 6), rep(0, 6), data2)
  
  coul <- c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3")
  colors_border <- coul
  colors_in <- scales::alpha(coul, 0.3)
  
  pdf(file.path(out_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_spider.pdf")),
      width = 8, height = 6)
  
  op <- par(mar = c(3, 4, 4, 6))
  
  fmsb::radarchart(
    data2,
    axistype = 1,
    pcol = colors_border,
    pfcol = colors_in,
    plwd = 2,
    plty = 1,
    vlabels = c("Education",
                "Healthcare",
                "Household",
                "Employment",
                "Stigma",
                "Psychological"),
    cglcol = "grey",
    cglty = 1,
    axislabcol = "grey",
    caxislabels = c("0", "", "25%", "", "50%"),
    cglwd = 0.8,
    calcex = 0.8,
    vlcex = 0.8
  )
  
  par(op)
  dev.off()
  
  return(list(
    radar_web = radar_web,
    dimension_table = dimension_table
  ))
}
```

```{r}
spider_results <- purrr::imap(
  dataset_list,
  ~ make_spider_chart(data = .x, dataset_name = .y)
)


safe_sheet_name <- function(name, suffix, existing_names) {
  base <- substr(paste0(name, "_", suffix), 1, 31)
  
  i <- 1
  new_name <- base
  while (new_name %in% existing_names) {
    extra <- paste0("_", i)
    new_name <- substr(base, 1, 31 - nchar(extra))
    new_name <- paste0(new_name, extra)
    i <- i + 1
  }
  return(new_name)
}

library(openxlsx)

wb_all <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
existing_sheets <- c()

purrr::imap(spider_results, function(res, nm) {
  
  # create safe + unique names
  sheet_dim <- safe_sheet_name(nm, "dim", existing_sheets)
  existing_sheets <<- c(existing_sheets, sheet_dim)
  
  sheet_rad <- safe_sheet_name(nm, "radar", existing_sheets)
  existing_sheets <<- c(existing_sheets, sheet_rad)
  
  # write dimension table
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb_all, sheet_dim)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb_all, sheet_dim, res$dimension_table)
  
  # write radar table
  radar_df <- res$radar_web %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Group")
  
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb_all, sheet_rad)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb_all, sheet_rad, radar_df)
})

openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
  wb_all,
  "results/spider_webs/all_spider_outputs.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# summarize percent deprived in each dimension by dementia group
plot_data <- MP_all %>%
  select(rudas_3c, all_of(items)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(items),
    names_to = "Dimension",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(rudas_3c, Dimension) %>%
  summarise(
    percent = mean(value == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Dimension = factor(Dimension, levels = rev(items)),
    Dimension_label = recode(Dimension, !!!item_labels)
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = percent, y = Dimension_label, fill = rudas_3c)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(percent, 1)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "% deprived in each dimension",
    y = "Dimensions",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```
